name: ingest-batch
description: An ingestion context belongs to the request, not to one operation (§71.1): one entry is one Evidence, whichever operations cite it. Outside `atomic` mode every KML operation is its own transaction (§75), so a batch of two would mint the observation twice — two records nothing could tell apart from two observations. The request is therefore refused unless every entry carries `client_key`, through which each transaction resolves the same Evidence as a retry of one creation. A request that opens one write transaction needs no key, and one whose only KML operation is a standalone `DEFINE` opens none and is refused, as a read-only one is (request-envelope.json).

Option.description: A preference option used by these fixtures. A real Space types each option by its kind (Profile §5.5, §7), because prefers partitions by the option's Concept Type; one catch-all type is one partition.
